name: Bybit WSOT 2026
steps: Check you can enter. You can't if you live in the EEA or another restricted region, or if you're a market maker, an institution or Pro 3 or above. Warning Don't use a VPN. Bybit's restricted-countries page says a false location can lead to "termination of any Account immediately and liquidating any open positions".
Complete identity checks. "Users must complete Identity Verification Lv. 1 to be eligible for WSOT." Only Unified Trading Accounts (UTA) count.

Register on the WSOT 2026 event page . Type bybit.com yourself and avoid links from strangers. "Register each eligible account separately. You may register up to 1 UTA Main Account and 6 UTA Subaccounts."

Choose how to compete. "Traders can join a squad and compete solo at the same time, or compete solo only." To join a squad, Bybit's announcement gives 19 November at 10:00 UTC. Its Learn guide says members can't leave or switch after 13 November at 09:30 UTC, so join before then to be safe.
Do the Preheat Quest tasks on your main account.
For leaderboards, fund the account: "To activate a PnL or PnL% leaderboard entry, you need to maintain at least 100 USDT in equity for five minutes."
Trade in your track's window and meet its volume minimum. Rewards are paid within 30 days after the end.
what: Bybit WSOT 2026 is a trading competition, not an airdrop: up to 10M USDT in prizes across five tracks until 2 December. EEA residents can't enter.
behind: WSOT is run by Bybit, a centralized exchange. CNBC named Ben Zhou as its chief executive in February 2025. Blockhead reported in October 2026 that its Dubai licence lets "its local entity, Bybit Fintech FZE, to offer spot trading in the emirate", which doesn't cover derivatives. The pages we read don't say which Bybit company runs WSOT. Bybit lost about $1.5 billion to a theft in February 2025. Th
costs: Registering is free: "There is no minimum equity to register." Competing isn't. Leaderboards need at least 100 USDT of your own money, squad members need 50,000 USDT of qualifying volume, and every trade pays Bybit's normal fees. We didn't find a fee rate in the event pages.
